text: Distance labels, relabel, gap.

ISAP (Improved Shortest Augmenting Path) keeps a distance label d[v] = distance from v to the sink in the residual graph, computed once by BFS from t. It only pushes along edges with d[u] = d[v] + 1; when u has no such edge, it relabels d[u] to 1 + the smallest label among its usable neighbours, instead of rebuilding all levels as Dinic does.

Gap optimisation: keep cnt[k] = number of vertices with label k. If relabelling empties some cnt[k], no path from s to t can exist any more, so stop. With current-arc and gap, ISAP is usually as fast as or faster than Dinic, and needs only one BFS.

The first test is the sample of 第1章(50); the second is a random graph checked against a separate Edmonds–Karp in Python (BFS shortest augmenting paths, the simplest correct max-flow method). Ford– Fulkerson = any augmenting path; Edmonds–Karp = shortest by BFS, O(nm²); Dinic and ISAP = layered, O(n²m).
Orient, parity, flow to fix.

Euler circuit in a mixed graph (混合图的欧拉回路): some edges are directed, others may be oriented either way. Orient the undirected edges arbitrarily and compute xv = out(v) − in(v). Every xv must be even (flipping an edge changes it by 2). Then decide which undirected edges to flip with a flow: flipping u → v moves 2 from xu to xv.

Build: each undirected edge oriented u → v gives a flow edge u → v of capacity 1 (flipping it); s → v with capacity xv/2 for xv > 0, v → t with capacity −xv/2 for xv < 0. A circuit exists iff the flow saturates all source edges (and the edges are connected). Bridges (P3511) binary-searches a limit and runs this test.

Equivalence classes; three views of one object.

endpos and equivalence classes: endpos(t) = the set of positions where substring t ends in s. Substrings with the same endpos form one class, and each class is one state of the suffix automaton (第3章). Within a class the strings are suffixes of each other with consecutive lengths len[link[v]] + 1 … len[v]; a shorter suffix has a larger (or equal) endpos set, which is why suffix links point to the next larger set and form a tree.
The number of occurrences of a state = |endpos| = the number of prefix-end states in its link subtree; that is the counting used in 第3章 's sam.cpp.

A suffix tree (后缀树) is the trie of all suffixes of s$ with every chain of single-child nodes compressed into one edge labelled by a substring: at most 2n nodes. Each leaf is a suffix; the path label of an internal node is a substring that repeats.

Three structures, one object: the suffix tree of s is the link tree of the suffix automaton of reversed s; its leaves read in lexicographic edge order give the suffix array, and the string depth of the LCA of two leaves is their LCP (height). In contests the suffix array or SAM replaces an explicit suffix tree (Ukkonen's construction is long and error-prone).
